title: Alpine Meadow ABC
hook: Meadow detail, mountain distance—hold them both in view.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: fresh 3D alpine meadow storybook, wildflowers grass and distant peaks, soft daylight, crisp recognizable subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child shifting focus from close meadow details to huge alpine background
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: reset near-small versus far-wide visual scale
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: airy 6/8 with close-detail pizzicato and wide held phrases
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written scale shifts; human gear and garden-mapping helpers are framed honestly
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: near/far cue -> recall beat -> target -> point/shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. small echo responses after targets, with acoustic walking pulse
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: small echo responses after targets, with acoustic walking pulse
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make the alpine meadow song about small life inside a huge landscape: grass, flowers, seed-carrying birds, rocks, shelter and weather scale are contrasted without calling every mapping target meadow flora.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child kneels visually into meadow scale, then looks back to glacier and mountain scale; the writing alternates tiny details and vast background.
semanticArc: notice birds, plants and ground textures
pull focus outward to ice and mountain
return to a careful camp-edge view
